field.name: oh_bracket_1_limit
field.comment: OH tax bracket 1 upper limit - 0% rate applies (2025)

field.name: oh_bracket_2_rate
field.comment: OH tax rate for bracket 2 - 2.75% (2025): $342.00 plus 2.75% of Ohio taxable income over $26,050, as the 2025 IT 1040 booklet (tax.ohio.gov) and R.C. 5747.02 print it. The printed over-$100,000 base, $2,394.32, is $360.69 (the 2024 base) + 2.75% x $73,950, not $342.00 + 2.75% x $73,950 = $2,375.63; the inconsistency is Ohio own, and the printed figures are used as published (#1317).

field.name: oh_bracket_3_rate
field.comment: OH tax rate for bracket 3 (income > $100,000) - 3.125% (2025): $2,394.32 plus 3.125% over $100,000, as the 2025 IT 1040 booklet and R.C. 5747.02 print it; $2,394.32 is consistent only with the 2024 bracket-2 base $360.69 (see oh_bracket_2_rate) (#1317).
